rows.grounds: numeral element specifying the count of thousands
locative plural indicating the domain of multitude
compound denoting devices or frameworks of birth or origin
past passive participle describing beings subjected to affliction

items.question: What vast multitude of womb-mechanisms subjects beings to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
items.inference: Beings experience torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
